tool_args.rationale: All five paid observations show positive gain at H≤0.48. A measurement near H=20 directly tests whether the gain turns negative and constrains the slow adaptation term near the target horizon of 24.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the amplitude-to-timescale ratio. Different slow amplitudes and timescales can fit the pilot yet predict different outcomes at H=24.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have s_grad=0, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable.
Finer short-window sampling is less direct than a long-horizon measurement for testing the predicted reversal.
